newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures rally in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures rally in late trade.

text.p: Aug 18 - Most U.S. stock index futures extended their early afternoon rally to post fresh session peaks in most contracts. Sept S&P 500 rushes to 912.75, above the 908.00 morning high. Market jittery, prone to whipsaws after Friday's steep slide. Debt futures ended firm, off highs, and stock index futures extended gains after debt close. No upside Sept S&P limit.
